steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A population is the entire group being studied; a sample is a subset of the population. | Key Fact: Sampling is used when studying the whole population is impractical due to time, cost or access. | Key Fact: A random sample gives every member of the population an equal chance of being selected. | Key Fact: Random sampling can be done using random number tables, calculators or computers.
